text:
anya: FYI - EU edge warm pool down ~40% over last 15m. Node bootstrap failing on keystore decrypts. Seeing AccessDenied from KMS-ish flow. 👀

sam: copying logs from one failing node: 
```
2026-03-22T08:41:12Z node-184 boot: keystore: decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: Caller not authorized for Decrypt
requestId=abcd-1234 region=eu-west-1
stack: keystore/ephem-signer.go:92
```

anya: stacktrace points to ephem-signer talk to keystore-proxy during instance init. Nodes never reach Ready. Warm pool shrink -> scheduler backfills but GPU capacity hit.

julien: any recent IAM/KMS policy rollouts? Did someone tighten a condition?

security-bot: automated alert -> CloudTrail shows policy change 5m before first failure: principal=infra-ci-role pushed condition `RequireMFA=false` -> change id ct-2026-03-22-771. Link: https://cloudtrail.example/org/ct-2026-03-22-771 (audit log)

lee: quick cost note if we reroute: shifting 30% of training jobs to us-west to avoid eu warm pool would add NAT egress + cross-region KMS calls. Rough calc: 30% * 250TB/mo * $0.09/GB = ~ $6750/mo (~$225/day) plus NAT GW ~ $1k/day at burst. (very approximate)

sam: verified keystore-proxy logs show spike in 403s from edge-join agent: 
```
2026-03-22T08:40:58Z keystore-proxy: auth denied: caller=ephem-join svc=ephem-signer reason="iam condition failed" cloudtrail_event_id=ct-2026-03-22-771
```

anya: interesting — the policy change looks like it tightened an IAM condition that now rejects ephemeral instance profiles used by edge boot. Those profiles rely on `aws:RequestTag/ephemeral` tag.

julien: we can't just open broad exceptions. Proposal: create a timeboxed IAM exception limited to the specific edge-join role + resource + condition for 30 minutes, with full audit and a manual approval (SRE + Sec). Then patch keystore-proxy to exponential-retry on 403->retry instead of abort. Also run canary of 2 nodes before mass roll.

lee: cost tradeoff: temporary exception (30m) -> almost zero cost but risk audit noise. Reroute cross-region -> immediate capacity but high egress/NAT charges and increases audit events across regions. I prefer the timeboxed exception + retry + canary.

anya: agree. Plan I'd like to run now (short):
1) sam -> deploy keystore-proxy retry patch to staging and start 2-node canary in eu-edge (10m window).
2) julien -> create timeboxed IAM change (15m) + sign-off. We'll attach CloudTrail snapshot and Jira.
3) lee -> estimate and open cost ticket if we need cross-region fallback.
4) anya -> monitor warm pool, bootstrap success metric and audit qps.

sam: patch ready, will push to staging now. Command I used to validate auth from a node: 
```
curl -sS -H "X-Instance-Role: ephem-join" https://keystore-proxy.internal/health | jq .
{"status":"denied","reason":"iam condition failed","event":"ct-2026-03-22-771"}
```

security-bot: created presigned CloudTrail export -> s3://redwood-audit/tmp/ct-2026-03-22-771.json (read-only link).

julien: creating short-lived exception in IAM; will annotate with Jira INFRA-4629 and require two approvals. I will not auto-apply: I'll wait for sam to confirm staging canary green.

ops-bot: runbook link for keystore boot failures: https://internal.runbooks/keystore-boot (follow step 2b -> temp-role-exception).

sam: staging canary started (2 nodes). Patch applied to staging keystore-proxy; logs show retries kicking in and second attempt succeeds for one node. Monitoring bootstrap->Ready.

anya: nice. Once julien applies exception for 15m we can scale canary to 10 nodes and watch jetty. If all good, roll to warm pool and monitor latency and audit-log qps. Note: watch retention costs — audit qps will spike, suggest lee temporarily lower retention ingestion window from 30d->7d for the audit-sampler pipeline for the next 24h (saves index cost).

lee: will prepare retention change toggle but will only flip after Sec sign-off. Estimate: reducing retention saves ~$2k/day during spike.

julien: applied IAM change in sandbox and posted Terraform diff in INFRA-4629 comment. Waiting for sam to confirm green.

sam: canary green on 10 nodes. Boot success 98% vs 0% before. No other errors.

julien: rolling exception in prod for 15 minutes now. Logged CT export and linked Jira. Everyone keep eyeballs.

anya: monitoring metrics: warm pool +28 nodes in 12m, bootstrap latency back to normal, total nodes in EU warm pool back to 95% healthy. Audit qps currently at 4x baseline.

lee: holding off retention change until we have final confirmation. Will queue toggle if qps stays >3x for another hour.

julien: exception will auto-revoke in 15m. After revoke we must confirm nodes remain healthy; if nodes fail again we'll need a different long-term fix (policy rewrite or new onboarding tag flow).

anya: postmortem notes to collect: exact policy diff, why ephemeral tag check caught this, keystore retry hard-fail path, and cost decision (reroute vs exception). I'll own the follow-up doc.

sam: action items: monitor for 2 hours, collect failed bootstrap CloudTrail events, upload to INFRA-4629.

anya: thanks team. :thumbsup:
